items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Not Freddie David. What's his name? Louis. Louis Kepler.

ctx.x: Yeah Cal's been around for quite some time too. Yeah Cal Blunt, Eddie Richardson, and Freddie Kepler. Freddie. Yeah well. Not Freddie David. What's his name? Louis. Louis Kepler. Louis Kepler. He's with us.
He played in the brass band though. And the snare drummer. How old is he?
